## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `customer` | `object` | no | The rule settings for customer metadata. |
| `customer.metadata_validation` | `string` | no | Off (the default): no rule is enforced. On: every later metadata write is checked. Stored data is never changed. One of `on`, `off`. |
| `customer.strict` | `boolean` | no | Refuse a path that no rule covers. Takes effect only while metadata_validation is on. |
| `subscription` | `object` | no | The rule settings for subscription metadata. |
| `subscription.metadata_validation` | `string` | no | Off (the default): no rule is enforced. On: every later metadata write is checked. Stored data is never changed. One of `on`, `off`. |
| `subscription.strict` | `boolean` | no | Refuse a path that no rule covers. Takes effect only while metadata_validation is on. |
